quarterly_data.quarter: GlobalFoundries press release: GlobalFoundries reaches agreement to establish U.S.-based (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GF announced a multi-year $2 billion manufacturing agreement with TSMC to establish a U.S.-based supply of silicon interposers for TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging ecosystem: GF will provide manufacturing service to TSMC and add fabrication capacity at its Malta, New York facility. GF expects to expand Malta capacity and establish what it calls the first U.S.-based source of silicon interposers supporting advanced packaging technologies, including embedded deep trench capacitor components. Volume production is expected to begin ramping at Malta during the first half of 2028; the agreement has an initial term of five years and provides a framework for future capacity expansion as customer demand grows.
quarterly_data.figure: multi-year $2 billion agreement; initial term of five years; volume production ramp expected first half of 2028 (Malta, New York)

contracts.source: GlobalFoundries press release: GlobalFoundries reaches agreement to establish U.S.-based (10-08-2026)
contracts.signal: Manufacturing agreement under which GF provides manufacturing service to TSMC, establishing a U.S.-based supply of silicon interposers (including embedded deep trench capacitor components) for TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging ecosystem, with added fabrication capacity at GF's Malta, New York facility. Volume production is expected to begin ramping during the first half of 2028. GF SVP of CMOS Business Ed Kaste: 'By providing manufacturing service using GF's trusted U.S. manufacturing footprint, we are creating a secure, scalable source of essential advanced-packaging elements.'
